beats.caption: Goladoo, in the civil parish of Donegal and the barony of Tirhugh. Here is the story of Goladoo and its sixteen families, from 1873 to 1926.
The parish register of Tawnawilly records nine baptisms at Goladoo between 1873 and 1875. Its marriage entries give no townland, so none are placed here.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 90, 81 and 59 people in Goladoo, in 16, 17 and 15 households. Heads of household included Martin, Slevin and Timoney.
Here are the families of Goladoo, from 1873 to 1926. First, the Boyle and Martin families.
The Boyle family appear in the records from 1873 to 1926.
Ellen Boyle was baptised on 24 August 1873. Owen Boyle and Ellen Martin were the parents.
Michael Boyle was baptised on 3 October 1875. Owen Boyle and Ellen Martin were the parents.
Goladoo had one Boyle household in 1901, headed by Owen.
Goladoo had one Boyle household in 1911, headed by Owen.
Goladoo had one Boyle household in 1926, headed by Joseph.
The Martin family appear in the records from 1874 to 1926.
Denis Martin was baptised on 22 February 1874. Denis Martin and Anne Timoney were the parents.
Goladoo had four Martin households in 1901, headed by Daniel, Donal, Edward and Ellen.
Goladoo had five Martin households in 1911, headed by Ellen, Edward, Donald, Daniel and John.
Goladoo had two Martin households in 1926, headed by Eddie and John.
The story reaches 1926 here, with fifteen households in Goladoo.
The Slevin family appear in the records from 1873 to 1911.
Peter Slevin was baptised on 27 March 1873. Edward Slevin and Susan Dunnion were the parents.
Bernard Slevin was baptised on 3 May 1874. Bryan Slevin and Margaret Clarke were the parents.
Mary Anne Slevin was baptised on 8 June 1875. Edward Slevin and Susan Dunnion were the parents.
Goladoo had three Slevin households in 1901, headed by Bryan, Tully and Catherine.
Goladoo had two Slevin households in 1911, headed by Margaret and Peter.
The Timoney family appear in the records from 1874 to 1911.
John Timoney was baptised on 26 April 1874. Paddy Timoney and Margaret Martin were the parents.
Goladoo had three Timoney households in 1901, headed by John and two named Patrick.
Goladoo had three Timoney households in 1911, headed by Margaret and two named Patrick.
